name: STAND MY HEROES
original_name: スタンドマイヒーローズ
source:
An independent investigative agency that gathers a variety of people from all over Japan, commonly known as "The Stand."
The first mission given to you as a temporary member...
It was a scout for "Stand" members.

You are busy with scouting work for your boyfriend and others, which is not easy.
Eventually, he becomes involved in a big mystery.
The meaning of scouting, unsolved cases...
What is the truth and justice that you arrive at?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.colyinc.standMyHeroes]Google Play[/url]]
